_about: Mt. Fuji-view stays around Lake Kawaguchiko. Each hotel's view and access line comes from its own official site (source + checked). Booking links resolve through data/booking-hotel-urls.json (bookingKey), so a link is registered once. No ratings, prices, availability or rankings: none of them are verified. Order is by view and information quality, not by commission.

page.title: Mt. Fuji View Hotels at Lake Kawaguchiko
page.description: Three handpicked stays at Lake Kawaguchiko with Mt. Fuji views, what each hotel says about its views, how to get there from Kawaguchiko Station, and where to book.
page.sub: Handpicked stays with unforgettable mountain views.

heroImage.alt: Mt. Fuji rising above a lake with autumn leaves

viewNotes: Mt. Fuji is often in cloud. Clear mornings, especially in winter, give the best chance of seeing it.
Not every room faces the mountain at every hotel. When you book, choose a room type described as having a Mt. Fuji view.
What each card says about the view is the hotel's own description, checked on its official site.

page.areaCta: See all hotels near Mt. Fuji
page.routeBody: The Fujikyu Line runs to Kawaguchiko Station with Mt. Fuji on the left on the way up. See which side to sit on.

hotels.name: Mizno Hotel
hotels.line: A hotel 800 m up the hillside above Lake Kawaguchi, with private open-air baths on the roof.
hotels.view: The hotel says every room overlooks Mt. Fuji and Lake Kawaguchi.
hotels.access: Hotel shuttle from Kawaguchiko Station, 14:00–18:00 — call the hotel when you arrive. About 5 minutes.

hotels.name: Shuhokaku Kogetsu
hotels.line: A lakeside ryokan on the north shore, with hot-spring baths that look across the lake to the mountain.
hotels.view: The ryokan says every room looks out on Mt. Fuji and the lake.
hotels.access: Ryokan shuttle from Kawaguchiko Station, 14:30–18:30 — call when you arrive. Or take the sightseeing bus to the Itchiku Kubota Art Museum stop.

hotels.name: La Vista Fujikawaguchiko
hotels.viewSummary: Fuji view in some room types
hotels.line: A resort overlooking Lake Kawaguchi, where many rooms have a view bath facing Mt. Fuji across the lake.
hotels.view: Not every room faces Mt. Fuji: the hotel's Fourth rooms have no Fuji view. Book a room type described as facing Mt. Fuji.
hotels.access: Free shuttle from Kawaguchiko Station — reserve it in advance.
